question: Among them, can you show me the distribution and timeline of health inspections?
output_text:
### 1. Timeline of Health Inspections (2014–2025)

Inspection activity in the Salt Lake County Health Department record shows significant growth over time as digital tracking expanded:

* **2014–2017**: Early record adoption grew from **72 inspections** in 2014 to **244** in 2017.
* **2018–2019**: Inspection volume doubled to **461** in 2018 and **611** in 2019.
* **2020**: Experienced a sharp drop to **375 inspections** due to COVID-19 pandemic facility closures and service disruptions.
* **2021–2025**: Rebounded strongly, climbing to **621** (2021), **898** (2022), **908** (2023), **1,258** (2024), and peaking at **1,387 inspections** in 2025.

---

### 2. Distribution of Inspection Scores

Across all **8,020 total inspection visits**, health inspection scores (where **0 = Clean/Perfect** and higher numbers indicate more or more severe violations) follow this distribution:

| Inspection Score Range | Severity Level | Inspection Count | Share of Total |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **0** | Clean / Perfect | **710** | 8.9% |
| **1 – 5** | Low / Minor | **2,363** | 29.5% |
| **6 – 10** | Moderate | **1,938** | 24.2% |
| **11 – 20** | Elevated | **1,802** | 22.5% |
| **21 – 30** | High | **604** | 7.5% |
| **31+** | Severe | **603** | 7.5% |

* **Overall Average Score**: **10.29**
* **Inspection Types**: **94.1%** of all records are standard **Routine** inspections (7,543 visits), followed by **Follow-up** visits (254), **Critical Item** checks (216), and **Complaint Investigations** (7).

messages.content: How many establishments have a Salt Lake County health inspection on record?

messages.name: get_schema

args.query:
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM establishment_keys) as total_slchd_establishment_keys,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT slchd_establishment_key) FROM inspections) as slchd_keys_with_inspections,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM establishments) as total_gmap_establishments,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM establishments WHERE slchd_establishment_key IS NOT NULL) as gmap_establishments_matched_slchd,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT slchd_establishment_key) FROM establishments WHERE slchd_establishment_key IS NOT NULL) as unique_slchd_keys_matched_in_gmap

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_slchd_listings,
    COUNT(i.inspection_id) as total_inspections,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.slchd_establishment_key) as listings_with_at_least_one_inspection,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT i.slchd_establishment_key) as listings_without_inspections
FROM establishment_keys ek
LEFT JOIN inspections i ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key;

SELECT 
    ek_total.cnt as total_slchd_establishment_keys,
    ek_with_insp.cnt as slchd_keys_with_inspections,
    ek_total.cnt - ek_with_insp.cnt as slchd_keys_without_inspections,
    gmap_total.cnt as total_gmap_establishments,
    gmap_matched.cnt as gmap_establishments_matched_to_slchd
FROM 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM establishment_keys) ek_total,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT slchd_establishment_key) as cnt FROM inspections) ek_with_insp,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM establishments) gmap_total,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM establishments WHERE slchd_establishment_key IS NOT NULL) gmap_matched;

SELECT 
    'SLCHD Listings with Inspections' AS category, 1315 AS count, 'SLCHD Dataset' AS dataset
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'SLCHD Listings without Inspections' AS category, 26 AS count, 'SLCHD Dataset' AS dataset
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Google Maps Places Matched to SLCHD' AS category, 139 AS count, 'Google Maps Dataset' AS dataset
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Google Maps Places Unmatched' AS category, 8453 AS count, 'Google Maps Dataset' AS dataset

1. **SLCHD Health Inspection Dataset (`establishment_keys` & `inspections`)**:
   - **1,315 establishments** have active health inspection records on file (accounting for **8,020 total inspection visits**).
   - **1,341 total establishment listings** exist in the official SLCHD portal database (26 listings have no inspection visits recorded).

   - **139 establishments** in the Google Maps places dataset are matched/linked to an SLCHD inspection record (`slchd_establishment_key` is populated).
   - The remaining **8,453 establishments** (98.4% of the 8,592 Google Maps food service places) have no matched SLCHD inspection history on record.

messages.content: Among them, can you show me the distribution and timeline of health inspections?

args.query:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inspection_date) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS inspection_count,
    ROUND(AVG(inspection_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM inspections
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '0 (Clean / Perfect)'
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '1 - 5 (Low / Minor)'
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6 - 10 (Moderate)'
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11 - 20 (Elevated)'
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21 - 30 (High)'
        ELSE '31+ (Severe)'
    END AS score_range,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM inspections
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY MIN(inspection_score);

SELECT 
    COALESCE(it.description, 'Unspecified') AS inspection_type,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM inspections i
LEFT JOIN inspection_types it ON i.inspection_type_id = it.inspection_type_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT 
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inspection_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_inspections,
    SUM(CASE WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS perfect_inspections,
    ROUND(AVG(inspection_score), 1) AS avg_score
FROM inspections
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inspection_date) >= 2015 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inspection_date) <= 2025
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

args.title: Timeline: Annual Health Inspection Volume (2014 - 2025)
args.query:
SELECT 
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inspection_date) AS INTEGER) AS Year,
    COUNT(*) AS Inspections
FROM inspections
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inspection_date) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2025
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

args.query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN '0 (Clean)'
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '1-5 (Low)'
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 (Moderate)'
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (Elevated)'
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21-30 (High)'
        ELSE '31+ (Severe)'
    END AS Score_Range,
    COUNT(*) AS Inspections
FROM inspections
GROUP BY Score_Range, 
    CASE 
        WHEN inspection_score = 0 THEN 1
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 2
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 3
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 4
        WHEN inspection_score BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN 5
        ELSE 6
    END
ORDER BY 2 ASC
